text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Hokko Tarumae and 
Special Week shouting loudly in the plaza.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Who wants to sweat it out harvesting 
carrots together! We're looking for 
volunteers!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the farmers' generosity, we can 
eat freshly harvested carrots and drink 
delicious milk too!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san. Actually—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Are you recruiting volunteers?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm helping out at a carrot farm 
that's partnered with the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've helped with the harvest before as 
thanks for letting me purchase their 
stock, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
On top of having to head out to Hokkaido, 
turnout isn't great this time, perhaps due 
to the timing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so, I would like to ask you two 
Hokkaido natives to handle the 
recruitment.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I just need to promote what's great 
about Hokkaido so people will want to go 
there, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Understood, leave it to me. I'm quite 
confident when it comes to publicity!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Or so I said, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Barely anyone's gathered yet...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa, why'd it turn out like this~... 
Talkin' all that big game, and now I just 
look pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If this is the best I can do, I can't face 
the folks back in Hokkaido, ya know...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright then! Be sure to check out the 
local Tomakomai goods~!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hearing a dialect really does make you 
think of home, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I've never been there, but hearing about 
it kinda piques my interest!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "That's it! That's the one, Spe-san!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
? W-Which one? What are you talking 
about?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Dialects! I truly believe there's no 
better way to represent your hometown than 
through its dialect.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just hearing it brings a sense of 
nostalgia... If I use words that carry the 
warmth of the northern land—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! I see! That might make it easier 
to get people interested in Hokkaido!"

Afterward, we put Hokko Tarumae's plan 
into action—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's my first time in Hokkaido, no 
worries at all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Everrryone's wicked kind, so you're sure 
to have fun, eh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it comes with delicious carrots and 
fresh milk!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Above all, nature here feels so cozy and 
relaxing, you really ought to visit at 
least once!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Hokkaido, huh? I've actually been 
interested in going for a while~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're taking us along! Want 
to go together?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Excuse me! Two entries, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It all worked out somehow, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Plus, speaking in Hokkaido dialect 
to recruit people kinda got my energy back 
up.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Feels like I got back in touch with my 
original intentions.
choice_data_list:
Did you channel the power of your hometown 
or something?

Shall we channel that energy into 
training, too?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm not sure if it's quite something 
that spiritual, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"However, by using words that felt 
familiar to her, it might have helped her 
relax mentally."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san. If you'd like, would you want to 
train together after this?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Let's give it everything we've 
got with full Hokkaido power!!

Afterward, she brought out the full power 
of Hokkaido and devoted herself to 
training.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. I was just in the mood for a 
run myself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me too! Having been raised by the same 
land, I suppose we really do share a 
connection!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Alright then! Shall we head to training!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Let's give it our all!!

And so, riding that momentum, the two of 
them jumped straight into training.
